title: Server-owned checkpoint state
prompt: Complete the seed so touching CheckpointA records that checkpoint in the server-owned ReplicatedStorage.GameState folder. Give players clear feedback when the checkpoint activates and do not trust a client-provided checkpoint identity.
acceptance: Touching CheckpointA sets GameState's LastCheckpoint attribute to CheckpointA.
The server derives the checkpoint identity from the touched server instance.
The activation is visible to the player and causes no runtime errors.
evidenceInstructions: Keep the checkpoint at Workspace.CheckpointA and the shared state folder at ReplicatedStorage.GameState.
Expose the resulting checkpoint name through GameState's LastCheckpoint attribute.
Keep CheckpointA reachable on foot from the supplied EvalSpawn so the fixed worker can exercise the same physical touch path as a player.
